    <bpmn:startEvent id="START_MPO" name="MPO causes a change" />
    <bpmn:task id="CAUSE_CHANGE" name="Cause a change of the measuring point" />
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="MERGE_CHANGE" />
    <bpmn:task id="REVIEW_REQUEST" name="Review the change request" />
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="DECIDE_REQUEST" name="Request confirmed?" />
    <bpmn:task id="REJECT_CHANGE" name="Reject the change of the measuring point" />
    <bpmn:task id="CONFIRM_REQUEST" name="Confirm the request of the SP / PU / GO" />
    <bpmn:task id="PERFORM_CHANGE" name="Perform the measuring point change" />

    <bpmn:task id="REPORT_IMPLEMENTATION" name="Report the implementation to the SP / PU / GO" />

    <bpmn:endEvent id="END_FAILED" name="Change failed" />

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F2" sourceRef="REQUEST_CHANGE" targetRef="MERGE_CHANGE" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F3" sourceRef="START_MPO" targetRef="CAUSE_CHANGE" />

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F9" sourceRef="REJECT_CHANGE" targetRef="END_REJECTED" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F10" sourceRef="CONFIRM_REQUEST" targetRef="PERFORM_CHANGE" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F11" sourceRef="PERFORM_CHANGE" targetRef="DECIDE_RESULT" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F12" name="implemented" sourceRef="DECIDE_RESULT" targetRef="REPORT_IMPLEMENTATION" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F13" name="failed" sourceRef="DECIDE_RESULT" targetRef="NOTIFY_FAILURE" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F14" sourceRef="REPORT_IMPLEMENTATION" targetRef="END_REPORTED" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F15" sourceRef="NOTIFY_FAILURE" targetRef="END_FAILED" />
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
